ordering: Started after parent confirmed fixed theory section10 PHYS-MATH audit ledger. Earlier source read and subnormal finding were preliminary C2 inspection, not C9 approval.

checks.reason: tau=kappa*T, age x in [0,1], born in caller count convention; emitted tau=0 and survivor tau references separated. Physical W1=T*reported W1.
Both sides of all CDF jumps are checked. Positive plateau integrals equal the theory section3 expressions; each interval is split at the continuous quantile.
phi uses expm1; psi/chi Taylor coefficients match their positive integrals; large-tau scaled formulas avoid tau squared. Subnormal quantile uses the factored removable limit.

Direct/log mass fields and normalized shape are separate. A zero source or empty quadrature has shape=None. A positive underflowed mass can retain a mathematical conditional shape with an explicit absolute_mass_underflow flag.

No AgeHistory/state/cohort mutation, absorption, thermal, chemical or work update is introduced. Sorting acts on an owned copy for diagnostics. Parent118 bytes, including original 105 crate files, remain identical.

Global age mapping (elapsed_cells+x_local)/Nt and emitted weight w_local/Nt represent the stated constant-source reference. Cache reuse is restricted to identical scalar tau within a fixed family/refinement; source row identities remain distinct.

Source summary computes sum p_exact*d_label + half L1 difference in normalized label masses. W1 diameter is one and the CDF bound uses the same TV bound. It does not compute the exact unlabelled mixture distance.

Theorems hold in real arithmetic. API/docs identify outputs as binary64 evaluations without directed intervals; tests use floating tolerances. No executable returned bound is presented as an outward-rounded enclosure.

Invalid/nonfinite/negative masses and ages are rejected. Fixed-source CLI now requires strictly positive label masses. Original fitted NoForwardProgress is retained as a representational limit; no physical no-solution inference or CX-flow change occurs.
Reviewer executed 15 final diagnostic tests and a before/after synthetic zero-label CLI probe. Root post-review full 224 tests/Clippy/fmt and source 384-output byte parity are separately evidenced.

findings.phase: pre-C9 preliminary formula read and author implementation test
findings.observation: At tau=min positive subnormal and p=0.3, p*(1-exp(-tau)) rounded to zero. Initial W1 was 0.29 versus uniform 0.15.
findings.correction: For thin tau use p*phi(tau)*[-log1p(-z)/z], z=p*(1-exp(-tau)), with ratio 1 at z=0.
findings.scientific_impact: Original quadrature/native histories unchanged; corrected diagnostics.

findings.observation: The old source-study CLI accepted a zero-born label inside a positive inventory and exported its cached unit-source shape. The actual 384-source inventory has no zero-born labels.
findings.correction: Root explicitly documented and rejects nonpositive label mass in this positive-inventory CLI. Core compare_nodes(born=0) still returns undefined shape.
findings.scientific_impact: The existing 384-source scientific CSVs retain byte parity; no physics owner change.

limitations: f64 diagnostic evaluation is not a directed interval certificate
constant source and frozen opacity reference; evolving gas/opacity response needs the stated stability assumptions
mixture summary is an upper bound, not exact scalar-mixture W1
native crossed-grid findings do not establish universal second order or full longspan convergence
